lines.text: Adonijah asks Bathsheba to request Abishag the Shunammite as his wife from King Solomon.
Solomon swears Adonijah must die, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada strikes him down.
Solomon tells Abiathar to go to his fields in Hebron and banishes him from the priesthood.
Joab flees to the tent of the LORD, refuses to leave, and Benaiah kills him there.
Solomon forbids Shimei to cross the Jordan River, but Shimei goes to Gath, and Benaiah strikes him down.
